metadata.description: Multi-agent system shipping agentskills.io-spec runtime pipelines: music-video shorts production and Korean job-board digest aggregation.  Local-first ($0 runtime), Claude for one creative stage where quality matters, three-layer reactive audit.

plugins.name: music-video
plugins.description: Generate a 60-second 9:16 vertical music video from an operator-supplied music file plus mood keywords.  Phrase-aware ffmpeg shaders sync vintage visuals to music structure; beat-aligned cuts via aubiotrack, onset-aligned glitch micro-edits via aubioonset, pond-ripple + halation post-shaders.  Music is the sole audio — no narration, no captions.

plugins.name: job-hunt
plugins.description: Aggregate job postings from Korean job boards (사람인 / 잡코리아 / 원티드 / 프로그래머스) matched against operator filters (직군 + 지역 + 키워드).  Produces a dated markdown digest plus apply-assist links.  Locale-extensible by design — currently kr only, PRs welcome for other locales.  All four kr-* source plugins ship in mock-fallback mode; live HTTP per-plugin flag-gated.
